findings.issue: Uses `process.env` in client‑side code, which is undefined in the browser (Vite does not polyfill `process.env` unless using a VITE_ prefixed variable). This causes a ReferenceError and crashes the app on load.

API routes are defined without a leading slash (e.g., `route("api/v1/chat/completions", ...)`). This makes the paths relative to the current route, leading to incorrect routing and 404 errors for API endpoints.
findings.fix:
Add a leading slash to each API route definition:
```ts
export default [
  index("routes/landing.tsx"),
  route("/auth", "routes/auth.tsx"),
  route("/logout", "routes/logout.tsx"),
  route("/api/v1/chat/completions", "routes/api.v1.chat.completions.ts"),
  route("/api/v1/models", "routes/api.v1.models.ts"),
  // ...rest unchanged
] satisfies RouteConfig;
```
